entries.note: The context is read once at startup. Every tool checks the same sidecar instance and filters to the original root before reading a file or operating on a session. An agent cannot retarget by submitting another root ID or by following later GUI focus changes. Text/log output is bounded; SDK errors preserve failure instead of synthesizing empty success. This binding does not confine the coding CLI’s independent OS tools.

Require the original service instance and desktopActions version 1 before discovery or reload. Reload accepts only an explicit listed ID, scoped by the immutable bound root; it does not infer focus or expose arbitrary actions/commands. The result says accepted, not build completion. A retained older service produces a clear upgrade error instead of a hidden replacement that would strand live sessions. Loading service/MCP code is separate from native desktop reload.
